commit.message:
Regenerate for 2026-08-11; README link is now markdown, generated MDX-safe by the builder

The autolink fix on 2026-08-10 was applied to this file, which tools/build_dataset.js
overwrites on every build - so it came straight back and DataHub would have failed to
render again on the next push. The real fix is in the VisaChecker repo:
tools/dataset_templates/README.md, plus a build guard that refuses to write a README
containing a '<' or a brace outside code.
